    <div class="hero-card-bar"><i></i><i></i><i></i><span>gradient_descent.py</span></div>
    <div class="hero-card-math">
      <div class="label">The idea</div>
      <span class="math display">\theta_{t+1} \;=\; \theta_t \;-\; \eta \,\nabla_{\theta}\, \mathcal{L}(\theta_t)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-card-code">
      <div class="label">The code</div>
<pre><span class="k">def</span> <span class="f">gradient_descent</span>(grad, theta, lr=<span class="n">0.1</span>, steps=<span class="n">100</span>):
    <span class="k">for</span> _ <span class="k">in</span> <span class="f">range</span>(steps):
        theta = theta - lr * <span class="f">grad</span>(theta)
    <span class="k">return</span> theta

<span class="c"># minimise f(x) = (x - 3)^2</span>
<span class="f">gradient_descent</span>(<span class="k">lambda</span> x: <span class="n">2</span> * (x - <span class="n">3</span>), theta=<span class="n">0.0</span>)
<span class="c"># → 3.0</span></pre>
